Other route/character letter or mere level never substitutes
lifecycle.stage_commands: consume exact declared current-attempt inputs,grant exact declared current-attempt sealed bundles by quest_exchange,advance stage/record unique receipt in one05/19transaction after full final slot/weight preflight;nonfinal no XP/practice/silver/RNG or commission reward. Dialogue-only changes character revision once,not inventory. Sealed delivery variants are distinct item definitions,never alter source stack item_id in place
lifecycle.final_delivery: at exact final stage endpoint consume its attempt inputs plus previous commission when declared,then insert exact reward.items and carried silver;commit inputs/output source flows/state/completion/receipt/character and inventory revision each+1 once. No additional leader reward after final return;delivery NPC acts under exact quest reward authorization
lifecycle.silver: 62reward1200000 only to own carried_silver,warehouse unchanged;original+1200000 must<=9007199254740991 else reject whole final delivery,no clipping/deferred/partial credit. Authorized quest_reward income flow exact amount,zero amounts cause no fake flow
lifecycle.other_resources: all6experience0/practice0/rank_change null/ascension_progress0;no XP/level-award/practice mutation/refill/cooldown refresh or rank change;no reward RNG,box randomness only later explicit opening
lifecycle.commissions: each route commission1 minted only61final,commission2 only62final;stack1/0g/character+source quest+completion_receipt_id,without attempt dimension. Next quest checks true preceding completion and held source receipt,consumes predecessor letter only at its final transaction;cannot warehouse/discard/sell/trade/use/craft,never auto-regrant on abandon/missing proof. Abandon next task preserves previous letter,final consume not mirrored by persistent used flag
lifecycle.readiness: derive actual declared stage inputs and retained previous commission from source-verified carried items,not stored kill counters or ready flags
lifecycle.abandon: explicit confirmation clears only this active quest/current-attempt declared raw/sealed inputs,clears attempt/stage and resets not_accepted;prior completion-bound commission is not cleaned or refunded because not consumed yet. New attempt restarts own stage1,not earlier completed chain legs;completed cannot abandon
lifecycle.repeat: each source quest once per character across worlds,one route chain cannot satisfy other route. Route/configuration changes preserve histories and do not reset letter/reward or permit wrong-route actions
lifecycle.deduplication: same character/request same payload returns original durable result before current checks,never installs historical inventory;changed payload same request rejects. Stage receipt unique character/quest/attempt/stage;final completion unique character/quest. Old attempts/deaths/stages never act on new attempt
lifecycle.failure_and_save: any original/commission/source/endpoint/stage/route/final layout/weight/silver/revision failure rejects whole stage before mutation. Persist original transaction/receipts under05/19;uncertain save resolves original decision and retries same persistence,no business replay/duplicate reward/letter recreation
lifecycle.initialization: new role and known legacy1..4 explicitly not_accepted/null attempt/null stage/no task tokens/commissions or receipts;level/rank never auto-completes. New-format missing required state rejects
